points.description: Intermittent stream: has flowing water only at certain times of the year, when groundwater supplies the streamflow; it may be dry in dry periods (runoff from precipitation is only a supplemental source).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it flows seasonally/part of the year without mentioning groundwater as the source (or mentions groundwater but not seasonal flow).

points.description: Ephemeral stream: flows only during and for a short time after precipitation events; it is above the water table and groundwater is not a source of its water.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it flows after rain/precipitation without the short duration or the groundwater/water table contrast.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both streams described with their distinguishing source of water: intermittent flows seasonally from groundwater, ephemeral flows only briefly after precipitation with no groundwater input. Give part marks for a vague or incomplete description of one stream, such as seasonal flow with no groundwater mentioned. Give no marks for a wrong or swapped description. Each stream is marked separately.
